## LLM

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRISMAL_LLM_PROVIDER` | `str` | — | High-level LLM provider selector. When non-empty, ``default_model`` / ``fallback_model`` are auto-derived from the provider map unless the user also pinned a compatible explicit model. Accepted values (case-insensitive): '' (legacy / no override), 'anthropic', 'openai', 'google', 'ollama'. Set via PRISMAL_LLM_PROVIDER. |
| `PRISMAL_DEFAULT_MODEL`<br>aliases: `PRISMAL_MODEL` | `str` | `claude-sonnet-4-5` | Default LLM model (provider/model-id format for LiteLLM). PRISMAL_MODEL is accepted as an alias for convenience. |
| `PRISMAL_FALLBACK_MODEL` | `str` | `gpt-4o-mini` | Fallback model if primary is unavailable. Empty string disables the fallback wrapper entirely (use for single-provider setups like Ollama-only). |
| `PRISMAL_OLLAMA_BASE_URL` | `str` | `http://localhost:11434` | Base URL of the local Ollama server. Exported to the environment as OLLAMA_API_BASE so LiteLLM picks it up when routing ``ollama/*`` model strings. |
| `PRISMAL_TEMPERATURE` | `float` | `0.7` | LLM sampling temperature (0.0 = deterministic, 2.0 = most random) |
| `PRISMAL_MAX_TOKENS` | `int` | `4096` | Maximum number of tokens in the LLM response |
| `PRISMAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `int` | `60` | Timeout in seconds for a single LLM API call |
| `PRISMAL_LLM_OLLAMA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `int` | `300` | Timeout in seconds for calls routed to an Ollama model (``ollama/*`` or ``ollama_chat/*``). Local models are typically far slower than cloud providers — 60 s is not enough for a 7B-parameter+ model on CPU — so Ollama gets a generous override that takes effect automatically. |
| `PRISMAL_RETRY_ATTEMPTS` | `int` | `1` | Number of retry attempts on transient LLM API errors |

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |

| `PRISMAL_KOKORO_JUDGE_MODEL` | `str` | — | Optional judge model override (empty = default_model). |
| `PRISMAL_SOUL_MAX_BODY_CHARS` | `int` | `20000` | Max SOUL.md body length in characters (sanitizer cap). |

## Skynet swarm supervisor (Fase S, opt-in — SPEC-SKY-CFG-001)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRISMAL_SKYNET_ENABLED` | `bool` | `false` | Master opt-in toggle for the Skynet swarm supervisor. |
| `PRISMAL_SKYNET_SWARM_SIZE` | `int` | `0` | Swarm sizing mode: 0 = dynamic (the supervisor chooses N from the goal); >0 = fixed N sub-orders (load-balanced). |
| `PRISMAL_SKYNET_MAX_SWARM` | `int` | `8` | Hard cap on workers per round. Clamped to parallel_max_workers (the operator-visible ceiling always wins). |
| `PRISMAL_SKYNET_MAX_ROUNDS` | `int` | `3` | Hard cap on plan→dispatch→evaluate iterations. |
| `PRISMAL_SKYNET_REDUCE_STRATEGY` | `Literal['synthesis', 'concat', 'first_success']` | `synthesis` | How worker outputs merge: synthesis (LLM combine), concat (deterministic join), or first_success (earliest success). |
| `PRISMAL_SKYNET_WORKER_MODEL` | `str` | — | Optional worker model override (empty = default_model). |
| `PRISMAL_SKYNET_PLANNER_MODEL` | `str` | — | Optional planner/evaluator model override (empty = default_model). |
| `PRISMAL_SKYNET_TOKEN_BUDGET` | `int` | `0` | 0 = unlimited; >0 = soft per-run token budget. |

## Cost & Budget Governance (Phase C — SPEC-CST-CFG-001)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRISMAL_BUDGET_ENABLED` | `bool` | `false` | Master opt-in for the cost/budget governance layer. |
| `PRISMAL_BUDGET_MAX_TOKENS` | `int` | `0` | Per-run token ceiling (0 = unlimited). |
| `PRISMAL_BUDGET_MAX_COST_USD` | `float` | `0.0` | Per-run estimated USD ceiling (0 = unlimited). |
| `PRISMAL_BUDGET_MAX_CALLS` | `int` | `0` | Per-run LLM call ceiling (0 = unlimited). |
| `PRISMAL_BUDGET_MAX_WALL_CLOCK_S` | `float` | `0.0` | Per-run wall-clock ceiling in seconds (0 = unlimited). |
| `PRISMAL_BUDGET_SCOPE` | `str` | `turn` | Budget accounting scope: turn \| session \| tenant. |
| `PRISMAL_BUDGET_SOFT_RATIO` | `float` | `0.8` | Fraction of a limit at which a soft cap (degrade) fires. |

| `PRISMAL_BUDGET_PRICING` | `dict[str, dict[str, float]]` | `{}` | Fallback per-model pricing for models LiteLLM cannot price: {"model": {"input": usd_per_1k, "output": usd_per_1k}}. |

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |

## A2A interop (Phase I, opt-in — SPEC-A2A-007)

## CodeAct Agent (Phase 38 / SPEC-040; hardened by Phase 42 / SPEC-044)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRISMAL_CODEACT_ENABLED` | `bool` | `false` | Toggle CodeAct agent. Default is FALSE after SPEC-044 hardening — CodeAct still runs in a host subprocess (isolation comes in Phase 43 / SPEC-045), so operators must explicitly opt in. When False the supervisor downgrades any 'codeact' routing decision to the classic ReAct 'coder' node (see supervisor.py). Do NOT enable in production without also configuring a real sandbox isolation backend. |
| `PRISMAL_CODEACT_MAX_ITERATIONS` | `int` | `6` | Max generate/correct cycles per CodeAct invocation. |
| `PRISMAL_CODEACT_IMPORT_ALLOWLIST` | `str` | `pathlib,json,re,typing,datetime,collections,itertools,functools,math,statistics,random,hashlib,base64,csv,io,pandas,numpy,polars,matplotlib,sklearn,torch,flaml,duckdb,requests,httpx` | Comma-separated list of packages CodeAct code blocks may import. Any non-allowlisted import blocks execution. SPEC-044 AC-044-5 removed 'os', 'sys', 'subprocess' from the default; they must be added explicitly by operators who accept the risk, and even then are still subject to the AST denylist (SPEC-044 AC-044-1, AC-044-2, AC-044-3). |

## Sandbox Process Isolation (Phase 43 / SPEC-045)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRISMAL_IS_PRODUCTION` | `bool` | `false` | Production-deployment marker. When True, the sandbox isolation factory rejects the 'none' backend (CLAUDE.md Phase 43 rule #2) so that operators cannot accidentally deploy Prismal without real process isolation. Defaults to False so dev / test environments are unaffected. Flip via PRISMAL_IS_PRODUCTION=true. |
| `PRISMAL_SANDBOX_ISOLATION_REQUIRED` | `bool` | `false` | When True, ``SandboxExecutor.run_code()`` must delegate to a real isolation backend (docker / podman / nsjail / bwrap / firejail) and refuses to fall back to the unisolated host subprocess path. Default is False during the Phase 43 transition; flip to True once the deployment has at least one isolation backend wired and verified. |
| `PRISMAL_SANDBOX_ISOLATION_BACKEND` | `str` | — | Explicit isolation backend override. Empty string = autoselect via ``BACKEND_PRIORITY``. Accepted values: 'docker', 'podman', 'nsjail', 'bwrap', 'firejail', 'none'. The 'none' backend is a dev-mode fallback and is rejected when ``is_production=True``. |
| `PRISMAL_SANDBOX_CONTAINER_IMAGE` | `str` | `python:3.13-slim` | Container image used by DockerBackend / PodmanBackend. Must have ``python`` on PATH so the backend can launch ``python -`` and feed the user code on stdin. |
| `PRISMAL_SANDBOX_MEMORY_MB` | `int` | `256` | Per-invocation memory cap in MB (docker --memory). |
| `PRISMAL_SANDBOX_PIDS_LIMIT` | `int` | `32` | Per-invocation PID cap (docker --pids-limit). |
| `PRISMAL_SANDBOX_CPUS` | `float` | `1.0` | Per-invocation CPU quota (docker --cpus). |
| `PRISMAL_SANDBOX_TMPFS_SIZE_MB` | `int` | `128` | Ephemeral workspace size in MB. Mounted at ``/sandbox`` inside the container as rw,noexec,nosuid and wiped on container exit. |
| `PRISMAL_SANDBOX_ENV_ALLOWLIST` | `str` | — | Comma-separated list of env-var names to forward into the isolated environment. Default is empty — no host env is visible inside the sandbox. Keys matching the patterns ``*API_KEY*`` / ``*SECRET*`` / ``*TOKEN*`` / ``*PASSWORD*`` (case-insensitive) are rejected at parse time with a WARNING log, even if the operator tries to add them explicitly. |

| `PRISMAL_CONSTITUTIONAL_MAX_REVISIONS` | `int` | `3` | Per-principle cap on revision attempts before marking ``max_revisions_reached=True``. |
| `PRISMAL_CONSTITUTIONAL_PRINCIPLES` | `list[str]` | `["P001", "P002", "P003"]` | IDs of the principles enabled by default. The canonical set lives in ``prismal.agents.patterns.constitutional.DEFAULT_PRINCIPLES`` (``P001 no_harmful_content``, ``P002 factual_accuracy``, ``P003 no_pii_exposure``). Custom deployments may override with their own list via env var as a JSON array: ``PRISMAL_CONSTITUTIONAL_PRINCIPLES='["P001","custom-P999"]'``. |

| `PRISMAL_EXTENSION_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S` | `float \| None` | — | Default per-invocation timeout for @prismal_node (None = no timeout). |

## Tool provider injection (Fase Y)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRISMAL_TOOL_PROVIDER_MODE` | `Literal['global', 'context']` | `global` | Tool provider resolution mode: 'global' uses the provider injected via set_tool_provider() (variante A); 'context' resolves a per-session provider from the graph config (variante B, multi-tenant). |
| `PRISMAL_TOOL_PROVIDER_STRICT` | `bool` | `false` | If True, a missing tool provider raises ToolProviderNotConfigured instead of degrading to static stubs with a warning. |

## Config source injection (Fase W)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRISMAL_CONFIG_SOURCE_STRICT` | `bool` | `false` | If True, a missing injected ConfigSourcePort raises ConfigSourceError instead of falling back to EnvConfigSource — for hosts that must never read ambient environment. |
| `PRISMAL_RUNTIME_MODE` | `Literal['global', 'context']` | `global` | Runtime composition mode used by build_runtime(): 'global' injects process singletons (set_tool_provider); 'context' keeps every port inside the returned RuntimeContext for per-session/per-tenant use. Unifies tool_provider_mode (Y) and the vector-store mode (Z). Backward-compat: when runtime_mode is not set explicitly but tool_provider_mode is, runtime_mode is derived from it. |
| `PRISMAL_WEBHOOKS_ENABLED` | `bool` | `true` | Enable webhook delivery system. |
| `PRISMAL_WEBHOOKS_SIGNING_KEY` | `SecretStr` | *(secret)* | Default HMAC signing key for webhook payloads. |
| `PRISMAL_ML_ENABLED` | `bool` | `true` | Enable ML/DL pipeline subgraph |
| `PRISMAL_ML_TIME_BUDGET` | `int` | `120` | FLAML AutoML time budget in seconds |
| `PRISMAL_ML_QUALITY_THRESHOLD` | `float` | `0.7` | Minimum primary_score to pass model quality gate |
| `PRISMAL_ML_MAX_ITERATIONS` | `int` | `3` | Max retrain iterations on quality gate failure |
| `PRISMAL_ML_WORKSPACE_ROOT` | `str` | `data/workspace/ml_models` | Root directory for ML model outputs |
| `PRISMAL_ML_MAX_ROWS` | `int` | `1000000` | Maximum dataset rows allowed (safety limit) |
| `PRISMAL_ML_RANDOM_SEED` | `int` | `42` | Global random seed for reproducibility |
| `PRISMAL_ML_SHAP_MAX_SAMPLES` | `int` | `1000` | Max background samples for SHAP explainer |

## Phase 39 / SPEC-041 — Financial Pipeline Quality Gates

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRISMAL_FINANCIAL_MIN_CONFIDENCE` | `float` | `0.4` | Minimum MarketSnapshot.data_confidence required for the financial pipeline to continue past data collection. When missing_fields is non-empty AND data_confidence is below this threshold, the pipeline routes to END with an error FinancialReport. SPEC-041 AC-041-2. |
| `PRISMAL_FINANCIAL_TECHNICAL_MIN_CONFIDENCE` | `float` | `0.6` | Minimum TechnicalAnalysis.data_confidence required to run fundamental analysis. Below this threshold the pipeline skips fundamental_analyst and jumps straight to risk_sentiment_analyst, and the final report is tagged with a 'limited data' disclaimer. SPEC-041 AC-041-3. |
| `PRISMAL_FINANCIAL_HITL_ENABLED` | `bool` | `false` | Enable a HITL approval gate before delivering financial reports to the user. When True the report_generator's output is surfaced through hitl_gate() for human review; when False the pipeline ends as soon as the report is produced. SPEC-041 AC-041-4. |

## DateTime & Timezone (Phase 28)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRISMAL_TIMEZONE` | `str` | — | IANA timezone for the process (e.g. 'America/Caracas'). Empty = auto-detect from OS via tzlocal. |
| `PRISMAL_CRON_TIMEZONE` | `str` | — | Default IANA timezone for all cron jobs. Empty = inherit from 'timezone' field. |
| `PRISMAL_NTP_ENABLED` | `bool` | `false` | Enable NTP clock drift check. |
| `PRISMAL_NTP_SERVER` | `str` | `pool.ntp.org` | NTP server hostname. Only used when ntp_enabled=True. |
| `PRISMAL_NTP_SYNC_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `int` | `3600` | Seconds between NTP re-sync. Minimum 60. |
| `PRISMAL_NTP_WARN_THRESHOLD_SECONDS` | `int` | `5` | Log WARNING if NTP offset exceeds this many seconds. |

## LLM rate-limit retry

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PRISMAL_LLM_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_RETRIES` | `int` | `3` | Maximum number of LLM invocation retries on 429 / rate-limit errors inside the ReAct loop. 0 disables retry (legacy behaviour: fail fast and return an apology string). |
| `PRISMAL_LLM_RATE_LIMIT_BASE_DELAY_SECONDS` | `float` | `5.0` | Base delay in seconds for exponential backoff between LLM rate-limit retries. Attempt N waits `base * 2**N` seconds, capped at 60 s. |
